## How it works

<h3>Search</h3><p>Enter a name, property name or value and press Search or Enter to isolate matching components. Search is case-insensitive; every space-separated word must occur in the same component. GlobalIds remain searchable. A search with no matches hides all components; an empty search restores the full model. To inspect properties, click a visible component, then click 1 element selected at the top left to open Properties. If loading fails, click Search to retry.</p>
<h3>Developer integration</h3><p>The page queries all products through the published <code>viewer.IfcAPI</code>, including occurrence and inherited type properties, quantities, materials and classifications. Shared definitions are read once in bounded batches. The original West Riverside Hospital architectural model is hash-verified. Search results are isolated through BCF visibility exceptions using <code>bcf.save()</code>, <code>viewer.add()</code> and <code>viewer.selectTopic()</code>. The viewpoint preserves the camera and does not select or color components. Loading and errors use the viewer message API.</p><p>The page opens the original source bytes with <code>await viewer.IfcAPI</code>, reads native model data, then closes the model and disposes WASM before displaying the source with <code>viewer.add()</code>. See the <a href="https://thatopen.github.io/engine_web-ifc/docs/classes/web-ifc.IfcAPI.html">complete web-ifc API reference</a>.</p>
